description: Sagittarius decan 1 (November 22 to December 1): personality, love, work and growth, with Jupiter as sub-ruler of the first ten degrees of Sagittarius.
answer: In Western astrology, the first decan of Sagittarius covers 0° to 9° of the sign, roughly November 22 to December 1, with Jupiter as its sub-ruler, the sign's own planet. It is read as expansive optimism and the hunger for meaning, undiluted. Decans are a traditional refinement of the Sun sign.

sections.heading: Sagittarius decan 1 personality
paragraphs: Jupiter governs Sagittarius and also serves as sub-ruler of its first ten degrees, making this the most Jupiterian part of the sign. Traditionally that means generosity, faith in the future and an appetite for horizons of every kind, geographical, intellectual and philosophical. People here are often described as big-hearted, frank and contagiously enthusiastic. They tend to see possibility where others see obstacles and to assume, often rightly, that things can be worked out. Questions about belief, ethics and the purpose of a life are rarely far from their minds, even when the conversation looks casual on the surface. Their humour is frequently broad and generous.

Doubled Jupiter amplifies whatever it touches, which is both the gift and the hazard. Optimism can tip into overcommitment, with more plans than any calendar could hold. Promises are made sincerely and sometimes forgotten just as sincerely. A strong moral compass may occasionally harden into preaching, especially when they have discovered a new philosophy and want everyone else to share it. Yet the core of this decan is genuinely benevolent. They tend to lift a room, encourage people others have overlooked and treat learning as a lifelong adventure. When their vision is paired with a little patience, they make inspiring teachers, guides and companions.

sections.heading: Sagittarius decan 1 in love and at work
paragraphs: In love, this decan wants a fellow traveller. Shared adventures, whether a long trip or a new idea explored together, tend to keep the spark alive. They are usually warm, honest and generous with praise, and they rarely hold grudges. Freedom is non-negotiable, though; a relationship that feels like a cage loses its appeal quickly. Their frankness can land harder than intended. Partners who appreciate candour and share their curiosity often thrive with them. For their part, following through on small promises, not just grand gestures, tends to build the kind of trust that lets love grow roots.

Professionally, Jupiter's double emphasis suits roles with scope: teaching, publishing, higher education, travel, international trade, coaching, philosophy, outdoor leadership and any job that lets them share a bigger picture. They are often natural motivators who can rally a team around an inspiring goal. Bureaucracy and micromanagement tend to drain them quickly. The usual friction lies in detail, deadlines and the dull middle stretch of a long project. Pairing their vision with a methodical colleague, or simply breaking big ambitions into visible milestones, helps their enthusiasm carry through to the finish line.

sections.heading: Dates and sub-ruler of Sagittarius decan 1: what Jupiter adds
paragraphs: The first decan covers 0° to 9° of Sagittarius, which in most years means birthdays from November 22 to December 1. First decans take the sign's own ruler, so Jupiter rules both the sign and this decan, which is why it is often called the purest expression of Sagittarius. The other two decans of Sagittarius belong to Mars (decan 2) and the Sun (decan 3). Because decans are measured in degrees rather than days, the calendar dates drift by a day or so between years.

Jupiter widens the view, adding optimism, generosity and an appetite for meaning. Its decans are often described as more philosophical and adventurous, drawn to teaching, travel and big ideas, and sometimes prone to overpromising. Jovial decans are often linked with philosophy, scholarship, publishing, law and long journeys, and their usual lesson is to match vision with follow-through. Here Jupiter doubles up with the sign's own ruler, so Sagittarius's optimism, curiosity, candour and a hunger for freedom come through with little filtering.

sections.heading: Growth for Sagittarius decan 1
paragraphs: The growth edge for first-decan Sagittarius is learning that less can be more. A practical step is committing to fewer plans and seeing them through, which often proves more satisfying than juggling many. Before offering advice, they might pause to ask whether it has been requested. Listening as carefully as they speak tends to make their wisdom more welcome. Budgeting energy, and sometimes money, with the same honesty they bring to ideas can prevent burnout. None of this dampens their spirit. It simply gives their generosity a reliable shape, so the people around them can count on it.

Within Sagittarius, decan 2 leans towards adventurous conviction with a competitive, action-first edge and decan 3 leans towards visionary warmth with a flair for leadership and expression. A decan is one layer of a chart among many, so the Moon, rising sign and houses can strengthen or soften everything described here. These notes work best as prompts for reflection: notice which lines ring true, which feel foreign, and what that contrast suggests.

faq.question: Is the first decan of Sagittarius the luckiest?
faq.answer: Astrologers often associate this decan with good fortune because Jupiter, the traditional planet of expansion, is both ruler and sub-ruler here. In practice it is usually described as optimism and generosity that open doors, rather than luck arriving without effort.

faq.question: What are the dates of Sagittarius decan 1?
faq.answer: In most years November 22 to December 1, the days when the Sun is between 0° and 9° of Sagittarius. Birthdays at either end can fall in the neighbouring decan in some years.

faq.question: What planet rules Sagittarius decan 1?
faq.answer: Jupiter. In the triplicity system each fire sign's decans take the rulers of the fire signs in order, starting with Sagittarius's own ruler, Jupiter.
